description: Final result for the current marker. Report an unresolved marker when the inferred rule condition cannot be represented by the available tools, required layers or editable polygons cannot be identified, or a tool reports unknown. Use the reason from the evidence or tool. Use only coordinates and rule limits from the supplied evidence.

decision.description: Use completed after a passing local check for the current candidate. Use stop for an unresolved marker.

status.description: Use verified for a passing local check and incomplete for an unresolved marker. A local check covers only the current marker.
